name: UK Gov Contracts Finder B2B Buyer Tenders (Zero-Key)

parameters.content:
## UK Gov Contracts Finder B2B Buyer Tenders (Zero-Key)

Queries the official GOV.UK **Contracts Finder OCDS API** (`contractsfinder.service.gov.uk`) under Open Government Licence v3.0 with **zero API keys** or credentials.

### What it outputs
- `buyerName`, `buyerContact`, `buyerEmail` (`.gov.uk` / NHS / council), `valueGbp`, `deadline`, `noticeUrl`, and a compact `agentSummary`.

### Optional Scale & AI / MCP Integrations (MIT)
- **STDIO MCP Server:** `npx -y github:truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-mcp`
- **Python 3.10+ Stdlib SDK:** https://github.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-python
- **Hosted Skill / Docs:** https://www.agensi.io/skills/uk-gov-tenders-direct-buyer-emails
